item.text:
Hi [Organizer’s Name],

Could we consider choosing a route with more benches or regular places to rest? A few participants may appreciate opportunities to pause, whether because of age, mobility needs, health conditions, or simply a different walking pace. A more comfortable route could help everyone feel welcome and enjoy the outing without worrying about keeping up. Thanks for considering a route that supports a wider range of participants!

Best,  
[Your Name]
